dashboard_loading_bug.symptom: Dashboard cards visible on list but clicking shows 'Dashboard not found'
dashboard_loading_bug.root_cause: In dashboard_builder_routes.py, GET /{org_id} (line 105) catches requests meant for GET /{dashboard_id}. When frontend calls /dashboards/f28a37fd-... the router matches it as org_id='f28a37fd-...' and returns empty array
dashboard_loading_bug.reproduction: 1. Create dashboard with org_id, 2. Navigate to /dashboards/{dashboard_id}, 3. See 404 error
dashboard_loading_bug.fix_suggestion: Either: 1) Change frontend to call /dashboards/{org_id}/{dashboard_id}, OR 2) Add new route GET /by-id/{dashboard_id} that looks up dashboard without org_id
